dedupe_keys.name: livorno road maintenance reports and status statistics 2015 2016

description: The Municipality of Livorno publishes statistics about reports received by its road-maintenance office in 2015 and 2016. Annual components give monthly report counts and counts by processing status. The source defines six statuses: awaiting review, accepted, assigned, rejected, programming and closed. The two annual report containers belong to an annual-statistics container within the municipal road-maintenance series. Eight native metadata entries are therefore grouped as one source-defined series, with aggregate containers and component tables treated as overlapping representations. These data describe reported maintenance needs and administrative handling of the road system. A closed report is not evidence that a repair was completed successfully, and a report count is not a measured road-condition index. The descriptions do not establish report-level coordinates, repair costs, defects, processing durations or a specific simulation application. Related road-crash and physical-road datasets describe separate municipal transport information. Native DCAT metadata lists ZIP distributions and CC BY-SA 2.0. The files' internal tabular formats, present availability and accuracy were not verified. No maintenance records, archive contents or data rows were read.
